principles.close_range: LOD0 preserves source-backed exterior, cabin, lights, glass, wheels, brakes, silhouette, proportions and material/UV detail; mobile optimization must not be achieved by degrading the hero vehicle.
principles.identity: Exact identity plus model/generation/trim compatibility must be explicit before body promotion. Family matches, race variants and later generations remain evidence only until compatibility is resolved.
principles.distance: LOD1-LOD3 progressively remove invisible/small geometry and expensive material work while preserving silhouette, proportions, wheel placement, glazing and lighting readability.
principles.provenance: Every promoted component records exact source path and SHA-256 evidence. Ambiguous family/generation matches remain review-required.
principles.rights: Porsche is excluded under the current owner directive. Crown007 remains accepted/deprioritized and may inherit shared fleet improvements without blocking fleet expansion.
principles.runtime: Android-device performance remains an explicit acceptance item and may be pending; it must never be silently represented as passed.

lod_policy.note: No universal LOD0 triangle cap is used as a quality proxy. LOD0 fidelity and actual Android measurements decide whether further optimization is necessary.

source_state.car_parking: current 237-bundle catalog decode available; unresolved/conflict identities remain gated and rights policy is applied separately from source evidence
